column3: vt. 使处于危险, 危害
column5: Reckless spending now could imperil the museum's renovation plans for a decade.
column6: 现在胡乱花钱可能危及博物馆未来十年的修缮计划。

column3: n. 摇篮曲, 催眠曲, 轻柔的音乐
column5: The mother hummed a soft lullaby until the twins finally slept.
column6: 母亲轻声哼着摇篮曲,直到双胞胎终于入睡。

column3: n. 贱民(印度的最低阶级), 被放逐者
column5: After the scandal, the once-popular banker became a pariah among former colleagues.
column6: 丑闻之后,那位曾经广受欢迎的银行家在旧同事中成了弃儿。

column3: a. 无法抵抗的, 压倒性的, 强烈得使人无法忍受的
column5: The overpowering smell of ammonia forced the inspectors to evacuate the basement.
column6: 刺鼻的氨气味迫使检查人员撤出地下室。

column3: n. 凝乳;凝乳; 凝乳状物; 酪状物; 皂粒
column5: Lemon juice turns the warm milk into soft curd within minutes.
column6: 柠檬汁几分钟内就把温牛奶变成软凝乳。

column3: vi. 内爆, 向内破裂, 爆裂;内裂
column5: The doomed startup began to implode after its two founders resigned.
column6: 两位创始人辞职后,这家注定失败的公司开始内爆瓦解。

column3: a. 争辩的, 好争论的;n. 争论, 辩论, 辩论者
column5: The essay is a sharp polemic against standardized testing in schools.
column6: 这篇文章是猛烈抨击学校标准化考试的论战檄文。

column3: n. 分解, 分离, 脱离关系;离解; 离解作用
column5: Therapists describe dissociation as the mind's shield against unbearable stress.
column6: 治疗师称解离是心灵抵御难以承受压力的屏障。

column3: v. (使)复苏, (使)复兴
column5: Paramedics managed to resuscitate the swimmer after twenty minutes underwater.
column6: 救护人员成功让溺水二十分钟的泳者恢复了心跳。

column3: a. 贫血的, 患贫血症的, 无活力的;贫血的
column5: The company posted anemic sales growth despite an expensive holiday campaign.
column6: 尽管砸下重金搞假日促销,公司销售增长依然乏力。

column3: v. (使)大步慢跑;n. 大步慢跑
column5: The wolf began to lope effortlessly across the frozen tundra.
column6: 狼开始轻松地大步跨越冰封的苔原。

column3: n. 居民, 外籍居民, 外来语;vt. 给...居住权, 移植
column5: The octopus is a cunning denizen of the rocky coastal shallows.
column6: 章鱼是多岩浅海区的狡猾栖息者。

column3: n. 异教徒, 异端者
column5: In that era, anyone questioning the doctrine risked being branded a heretic.
column6: 在那个年代,质疑教义者都有被斥为异端的风险。

column3: vt. 贬低身分, 贬损
column5: Constant crude jokes can demean even the most confident new employees.
column6: 屡屡开粗俗玩笑会连最自信的新员工都贬损。

column3: n. 试金石, 检验标准
column5: Customer trust remains the touchstone by which we judge every campaign.
column6: 客户信任仍是我们评判每次活动的准绳。

column3: vt. 揭穿, 暴露, 拆穿假面具
column5: Physicists debunked the viral video claiming magnets cure chronic pain.
column6: 物理学家揭穿了那条声称磁铁能治慢性疼痛的爆款视频。

column3: vi. 正式脱离(或退出), 分离;退出, 脱离
column5: The southern provinces threatened to secede after the disputed election results.
column6: 争议选举结果公布后,南方各省威胁要脱离联邦。

column3: n. 洞穴, 岩穴, 洞室
column5: Tourists lit candles inside the small grotto behind the waterfall.
column6: 游客们在瀑布后方的小洞穴里点燃蜡烛。

column3: a. 紧张的, 拮据的, 心情焦躁的
column5: Try not to be so uptight; the interview is only a conversation.
column6: 别那么紧张,面试不过是一次交谈而已。

column3: n. 拖网;v. 用拖网捕鱼
column5: Detectives spent weeks trawling through archived phone records for a single clue.
column6: 侦探们花数周翻查存档电话记录,只为寻找一条线索。

column3: n. 美人鱼, 善泳的女子
column5: The harbor statue of a mermaid has become the city's beloved emblem.
column6: 港口的美人鱼雕像已成为这座城市深受喜爱的标志。

column3: n. 观看者
column5: Beauty may lie in the eye of the beholder, but craftsmanship is measurable.
column6: 美或许见仁见智,工艺却可以衡量。

column3: n. 预告, 预感, 征兆;先兆, 预兆
column5: She had a sudden premonition of danger and pulled the car over.
column6: 她突然预感不妙,便把车停到了路边。

column3: n. 独身者, 独身主义者;a. 独身的, 独身主义的
column5: The monk has remained celibate throughout his decades of monastic service.
column6: 这位修士在数十年修行生涯中始终独身禁欲。

column3: a. 骄奢淫逸的, 贪图酒色的, 妖娆的, 肉欲的, 激起情欲的, 色情的
column5: The ballroom's voluptuous curves and velvet drapes recall a more extravagant age.
column6: 宴会厅华丽的弧线和天鹅绒帷幔令人追忆更奢靡的年代。

column3: n. 平行, 对应, 类似, 比拟;并行性
column5: The speech's elegant parallelism made each promise easy to remember.
column6: 演讲优雅的排比让每个承诺都便于记忆。

column3: n. 小件饰物, 无价值的琐碎东西, 小玩意儿
column5: Street vendors sell every trinket imaginable, from shell bracelets to painted fans.
column6: 街边小贩售卖各种小玩意,从贝壳手链到彩绘折扇。

column3: vt. 使厌倦, 使苦恼
column5: It clearly irks the neighbors when our rooster crows before dawn.
column6: 我们家的公鸡天不亮就打鸣,显然惹恼了邻居。

column3: n. 门牙;切牙, 门齿
column5: The dentist repaired the chipped incisor with a tooth-colored composite filling.
column6: 牙医用接近牙齿颜色的树脂修复了缺损的门牙。

column3: vi. 摇摇摆摆地走, 蹒跚而行;n. 蹒跚
column5: Penguins waddle awkwardly on land yet glide gracefully through the water.
column6: 企鹅在陆地上步态笨拙,在水里却滑行优雅。
